children: Kao's earnings are increasingly driven by its cosmetics business, Jefferies says in a note. The cosmetics business's top-line increased 6.9% in 2025. Roughly 30% of the increase in operating profit in 1H was attributable to the cosmetics business, analyst Hisae Kawamoto says. The Japanese consumer goods maker's longstanding technological capabilities and channel advantages have begun to function as competitive edges, she says. Kao's products are delivering sales growth even as South Korean makeup brands gain market shares, she says. Jefferies raises its target price to 3,930 yen from Y3,750 and maintains a buy rating. Shares are down 0.1% at Y3,474. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
